name: mailgun
description: Send, route, and analyze email through Mailgun's transactional email platform via the official mailgun-mcp-server. Send transactional mail, manage domains, mailing lists, templates, webhooks, and inbound routes, query deliverability statistics, and review suppressions and dedicated IP pools.

interface.shortDescription: Send transactional email and manage deliverability through the official Mailgun MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Your agent can handle your email operations through Mailgun — sending transactional messages, checking deliverability stats, managing mailing lists, setting up webhooks, and reviewing bounces or complaints. Whether you need to send a password reset email, check if your domain is properly authenticated, or review your email analytics, your agent can do it all through conversation.
defaultPrompt: Check my email deliverability stats and bounce rate.
Set up a new sending domain and verify its DNS settings.
Show me recent bounces and unsubscribes.
